correctness.rationale: For two-state generator Q, u=a(1-exp(-(a+b)t))/(a+b), v=b(1-exp(-(a+b)t))/(a+b), and w=u+(1-u-v)epsilon. The entropy chain rule yields Phi=h(epsilon)+(1-epsilon)h(u)+epsilon h(v)-h(w). Its strict concavity follows from w(1-w)-(1-u-v)^2 epsilon(1-epsilon)=(1-epsilon)u(1-u)+epsilon v(1-v)>0. Fano and interior tests force the maximizer epsilon_t ->0; Phi'(Ct)>0 for each fixed C forces epsilon_t/t->infinity; the stationary equation then gives epsilon_t log(1/t)->a/(a-b). The Taylor error O(t^2/epsilon_t)=o(t) gives F=at(L-log L)+o(t) and the fair-prior equal-rate exact case. Boundary rates fixed positive, a>b, nonuniform as a-b->0. Source verifier code was read and its finite assertions classified as diagnostics; independent proof algebra checked, not a claim that the script was executed here.
